goal: Cut silent lane waits: reduce GitHub API quota sleeps from 900 to 120 seconds in pr-guards.yml and migration-author-lease.yml, and the queue-sensitive aggregate patience from 50 to 15 minutes (job timeout 60 to 25), so throttling no longer stalls merges.
prohibited_actions: Do not change any check name, job if:, concurrency group, or remove any step.
Do not bypass the fail-closed quota refusal behavior.
Do not touch migrations or database objects.
required_checks: python yaml parse of both workflows
assumptions: github-transport treats GITHUB_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECONDS as an opt-in cap and fails closed on refusal.
stop_conditions: Any behavior change beyond the wait bounds.
